meta.rows_old_library: cases a and c only, library sim/out/mpc_library.json
meta.case_e: world_model estimated (local wave fit, radar + forward scanner), wind from the estimator
meta.energy_trend: (E_end - E_start)/(t_end - t_start) * 60 over the last 60 s flown, E = g z + V^2/2

meta.planner_world_truth: world_model truth with the 48 strongest wave components

motor.folded_drag: prop.folded_drag_cda_m2 / S with the smooth switch, in the planner and in the true dynamics
motor.perturbation: Gaussian per knot, clipped to [0, T_max]
motor.burst: actual thrust above 0.01 of the weight

w_energy_levels.definition: w_energy = k w_e eta / m (cost per electric joule), k = free 0.03, normal 2, costly 4
w_energy_levels.how_chosen: pilot on the flat sea below the soaring minimum (baseline u10 6, 9, 11, albatross u10 9, 150 s): k 0.03 gives thrust on all the time (about 15 to 28 W); k near 2 gives the planner's working range; above k 4 to 5 the planner stops using the motor before the horizon shows the contact and the flight ends

flap_glide.note: steady flap-glide at best L/D with the same efficiencies (patterns.flap_glide_cost), wind independent

meta.motor_off_rows: case c of margin_exp where it exists (sea, flat planner world); the other motor-off rows are run here without the folded-propeller drag (motor off means no motor in the aircraft)
meta.energy_trend: (E_end - E_start)/(t_end - t_start) * 60 over the last 60 s flown, E = g z + V^2/2 (J/kg per min)

meta.true_wind: Wind(u10, 270, roughness='coare35') (flat sea) and the fully developed sea of seed 1 on that wind (waves): COARE 3.5 as the library and the optimizer; burst_exp used make_env with the Charnock constant. The planner's flat world takes the roughness of the true wind.
meta.thrust_sampling: sustained: half of the samples hold one half-normal level (scale 0.3 T_max) over a random run of knots, the rest independent Gaussian (ctrl.thrust_sigma_frac); candidates with constant thrust [0.05, 0.1, 0.2] of the weight, with the nominal controls and wings level at best L/D
meta.fold_switch: state: in the planner's rollouts and the true dynamics the propeller is folded (full folded drag) when the commanded thrust is below 0.005 of the weight and not folded (zero) otherwise, instead of the smooth switch; the optimizer keeps the smooth one

reflex.prediction: the plan's own controls, flat or truth world of the planner

meta.comparison: burst_exp: the normal-level row of the same aircraft, wind, sea and world (Charnock true wind, margin library, no sustained sampling); optimizer: the library entry at chi 20 deg of the nearest library wind (same margins, no ground effect, smooth fold, speed along chi from the optimizer; power in W is the average electric power)
meta.library_note: computed on the motor library of commit 8fa68be, before the upwind-side courses (120 to 180 deg), the calm-entry rotation and the raised-height upwind motor cycles were added; the experiment was not rerun on the current library file (about 40 flights of 180 s, hours of wall time)

meta.sea: flat, Wind(u10, 270, roughness='coare35'); wind from the west, toward +x
meta.targets: upwind = (-D, 0), across = (0, D) from the start at the origin
meta.navigator: sim.navigator.HullNavigator on the velocity hull of the library entries (HullSource, nearest library wind), arrival radius 200 m, called every 5 s (NAV_UPDATE_S)
meta.steady_leg: where no soaring pair makes progress the motor leg is a steady level flight at 10 m aimed by the wind triangle at the airspeed of least electric energy per metre (sim.navigator.SteadyModel), the planner's reference; the hull's 180 deg motor cycles stay as points
meta.planner: MOTOR_EXP_PKW plus thrust_update raw (the unbiased thrust update), guide heading tolerance 0.1 rad (NAV_GUIDE_SIG)
meta.prediction: sim.navigator.sail_hull on the same hull and navigator, tack pause 30 s
meta.t_end: 2 x the predicted arrival time + 600 s, at most 7200 s
meta.mean_vmg: (start distance - end distance) / time, in m/s

meta.wind_sea: the wave runs of motor_library_exp that ended early, rerun with its settings (run_motor_job: fully developed COARE 3.5 sea of seed 1, motor library, wave_aware False, 180 s) with every plan logged (PlanLog) and the trajectory kept
meta.swell: the same planner (flat-sea motor library picked at 20 deg off downwind, truth world) over one regular swell component, Hs 3 m, Tp 10 s, along the wind, P63 wave wind, second-order surface, 300 s, wave_aware False and True
meta.plans_last5s: the plans of the last 5 s: lowest wingtip of the nominal plan in the planner's world and against the true surface, mean number of dead samples (of 96)
meta.end: state at the last step against the true surface; eta_over_std is the surface elevation there in units of its standard deviation over the last minute at that point

meta.sea: swell_env: one regular long-crested swell component, Hs and Tp 10 s, along or against the wind (from 270 deg), COARE 3.5 log wind of u10 (calm flown at 0.1 m/s), the wave wind of the preset, second-order surface; the planner flies the same sea (oracle)
meta.start: in flat flight: the navigation's steady motor leg (level at 10 m above the local surface, airspeed of least energy per metre) along the swell's travel (flat_start_entry); the wave library's entry is taken at a wave-phase match (at most 60 s of waiting)
meta.wave_library: WavePilot policy energy: soaring entries first (crest rides first, slowest along-crest speed), else the least average power, unless that motor entry needs at least the flat library's least power at the wind (then the start's steady flat leg is flown on); guide WaveCycleGuide
meta.counts: ended complete and flight_margins valid: heights relative to the local surface inside the band of R-12, wingtip at least 0.3 m, no loop, no flight below the stall speed, load factor within its limit
meta.after_entry: average power, motor-on share and median height from the first switch onto a wave entry to the end
meta.flat: the flat motor library's entry of least average power at the same wind (any course)

meta.sea: swell_env (oracle), wind from 270 deg, swell running east (along the wind); the target lies across the swell's travel (north) or with it (east)
meta.hull: the wave library's entries at the sea and wind with their mirror images (sim.navigator.HullSource), the steady motor legs of the flat sea (SteadyModel)
meta.start: flat flight: the steady motor leg towards the target (flat_start_entry)
meta.arrival: within 200 m; counts_as_arrived also needs the band and the margins

meta.how: as wave_loop_exp, with fly_mpc(planner_world=...): the planner and the wave library's choice see the swell with its phase shifted by the given angle (phase) or its height scaled (height); the aircraft flies the true sea; the last row has no error
